_help: AutoResearch preset default config (seeds .research-agent/config.json in NEW workspaces; an existing workspace file wins). MODEL ASSIGNMENT IS CENTRALIZED IN roleProfiles BELOW: every role has exactly one entry there and its model is chosen in that one place. There is no separate roleModels bucket and no per-role tool list here — per-role tools are fixed by the built-in role manifest (the integration editor already carries read_image there). judgePanel is an optional per-judge override and only takes effect when research_judge.model is omitted. _recognizedModels is the pick list of valid 'provider/model' strings (refresh with autoresearch_list_models; unrecognized strings are flagged by autoresearch_dependency_check). The integration editor must use a multimodal model for visual inspection — the local-qwen-* providers below accept image input.
